question:
The sentence has been divided into three parts, identify the segment which contains a spelling error in the sentence given below. Choose no error if there is no error in the sentence.

The Chandrayaan 2 could have been a success/, if it hadn't lost the connection with the control room/ in the final momants of its landing.

options.text: in the final momants of its landing.
if it hadn't lost the connection with the control room
The Chandrayaan 2 could have been a success,

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the misspelling of the word "**momants**."
 
• The correct spelling should be "**moments**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 1** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The Chandrayaan 2 could have been a success, if it hadn't lost the connection with the control room in the final **moments** of its landing."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "if it hadn't lost the connection with the control room,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any spelling errors.
 
• **Option 3: "no error"** – This would be the correct option if there were no mistakes in the sentence, but there is a spelling error in part 1.
 
• **Option 4: "The Chandrayaan 2 could have been a success,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any spelling errors.

3c:T
